title: Priced Out of Broward
text:
Broward County, Florida




Where is rent hardest to afford? Explore the share of renter households spending at least 30% of their income on rent, tract by tract.

 2024 American Community Survey · 5-year estimates




Rent-burdened share65.2%of renter households with a computed ratio


Rent-burdened households169,949estimated across Broward County


Renter households274,613ACS estimate, all rent-to-income ratios


Census tracts417tracts in Broward County




Each shape is a census tract. Darker red means more renters are burdened—and rent is harder to afford.



Share of renter households paying 30% or moreHover over a tract for its estimate. The interactive map loads when available.

Households spending 30% or more of their income on gross rent. The tract share is burdened households divided by renter households for whom the ACS computed a rent-to-income ratio; households marked “not computed” are excluded from that denominator.



These are estimates from the 2020–2024 ACS 5-year survey, not a count of every household. A tract’s estimate has a margin of error, and small differences between neighboring tracts may not be meaningful. Map boundaries: U.S. Census TIGER/Line.



Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2024 ACS 5-year estimates, table B25070. Estimates retrieved from Census Reporter; boundaries from Census TIGERweb. Map tiles © OpenStreetMap contributors.
